title: Ghana hopes to attract investors after €3 billion IMF bailout ends
summary: Ghana's three billion dollar IMF bailout has just wrapped up, and it's now hoping that it has a better financial footing to tempt investors over. The country needed the support to ride its worst economic downturn in decades following the pandemic, Russia's invasion of Ukraine and inflation. FRANCE 24's Justice Baidoo is on the ground and spoke to Ghanaians…
